title: Rousing's Dungeon
description: This dungeon is being created as a passion project and has some cool features like: randomly generated structures, custom advancements, and a custom loot table
body:
This is a datapack that wants to add some more fun to the underground. It is a datapack that contains:
A randomly generating dungeon
A custom loot table
Advancements
This dungeon is a passion project and is not entirely complete (yet)
It is meant to be run in 1.21.5 Java and works for both, single player and multiplayer. So you can play with friends. The dungeon rating is a 5-7 with some hard parts and some easier ones.
